summary: Powell County, MT 10-foot pole L-4 tower on the Flathead NF, dated 1937; abandoned and gone; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: general description of the L-4 cab type
evidence.quote: It was a 14x14' wood frame cab, windows all around and either sitting on the ground or atop pole or timber towers up to 100 feet high.

sources.title: White River Butte Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only firelookout.com gives a build year, design and fate, and the Forest Lookouts page gives only the county, agency and survey location. The 1937 date and the abandoned-then-gone fate come from one source. No fate date, staffing or fire history was found, so none is written. The L-4 cab description comes from the Sanders County Ledger and is general, not specific to this tower. The index gives coordinates 47.55213, -113.28569; the survey location 21N-13W-28 was not checked against a map.
